name: kept-page-outside
about: A kept page outside Yap (16 Nov 2026, chat/made/pages.rs; built 15 Nov in #130): Chat's model keeps a small page (save_page), then its ⋯ beside the chat — Save as…, with Windows' dialog answered by the lab (the dialog plugin's IPC: a file in the lab's own saved/ folder, what the dialog suggested kept), and Open in browser, which test mode keeps as an address instead of opening the person's browser: the copy is read back and opened in the lab's own headless browser, light and dark. Both files carry the sandbox's policy and the page's own title; the copy runs with no console errors and nothing refused by its policy.

steps.ask: Make me a tip calculator page I can keep: a bill amount, a tip percentage slider from 0 to 30, and the tip and the total shown as you move it. Keep it small, with no libraries.

steps.note: A page Yap keeps (not a visual in the thread).
Save as… suggested the page's own name, .html added to a name with no ending; the file works on its own (the sandbox's policy, a title).
A copy in Yap's own temp folder, its file: address handed to the browser (here: kept by test mode).
The copy runs outside Yap: no console errors, nothing its own policy refuses (the model's page decides).
